project_scope.note: Canonical Liatris punctata teaches both accepted var. punctata and var. mucronata. Historical Liatris mucronata maps to var. mucronata and is not a separate learner.

study_strategy.warning: Do not count Liatris mucronata as a separate species. It is the historical concept now treated as L. punctata var. mucronata. Local stem-color/pubescence cues are helpful but corm and mature fruit remain stronger variety-level characters.

quick_split: var. mucronata — often glossy/reddish-stemmed locally; smaller more spheroid corm
var. punctata — often grayer/more pubescent locally; larger corm and larger hairier achenes
comparison_lesson.caveat: North Hays stem-color/pubescence cues are useful locally but should not replace corm and fruit characters elsewhere.

source_concept_status.learner_action: teach inside canonical L. punctata; no duplicate page
